description: Most Cambridge staff and students have a standard Microsoft licence with Copilot Chat access at no extra charge. Microsoft 365 application integration requires an additional paid licence; UIS currently lists approximately £300 per user/year and an A3 or A5 account for purchase. Institutional account access and commercial data protection do not grant assessment permission.
howToObtain: Purchase via UIS service request with an A3/A5 University account.
costToUser: Paid additional licence; UIS currently lists about £300/user/year.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Most staff and students at the University have a standard Microsoft licence. This includes access to Copilot Chat.
Most staff and students at the University have a standard Microsoft licence at no extra cost.
You must buy a licence, in addition to a standard Microsoft licence, to use Copilot with Microsoft 365. This costs around £300 per annum, per user.
Your account must have an A3 or A5 licence in the University Office365 tenancy.
